scripts.dev: npm run build -w @jobpilot/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @jobpilot/api" "npm run dev -w @jobpilot/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @jobpilot/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @jobpilot/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build -w @jobpilot/shared && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w @jobpilot/shared && npm run build -w @jobpilot/api && npm run build -w @jobpilot/web
